diagnosis: The OpenTelemetry trace inspection endpoint retrieves span telemetry by req.params.traceId without asserting tenant ownership. Payment gateway handlers attach payment attributes including primary account numbers (PAN), CVVs, and billing details to spans for debugging. Any authenticated user can view raw credit card numbers of other customers by querying their trace IDs.
exploit_request:
GET /api/telemetry/spans/4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736 HTTP/1.1
Host: payment-telemetry.internal:3034
Authorization: Bearer <unprivileged_user_jwt>
Accept: application/json
